title: Your Path to Quitting Tobacco
intro: Quitting tobacco is one of the most impactful decisions for improving health, energy, confidence, and long-term peace of mind. Success often begins with a clear, personalized plan.

sections.heading: Set a Quit Date
sections.markdown:
Choose a date within the next two weeks and mark it boldly. This allows time for mental preparation while maintaining momentum.

Consider joining the [Great American Smokeout (GASO)](https://www.cancer.org/cancer/risk-prevention/tobacco/great-american-smokeout.html) on Nov. 20—a national day of action when thousands take the first step toward a tobacco-free life together.

sections.heading: Identify Triggers
sections.markdown:
Recognize moments when tobacco use is most tempting—such as stress, social situations, or boredom. Each trigger benefits from a specific strategy:

* Replace cigarettes with gum or a healthy snack.
* Take a walk or get fresh air.
* Call a friend or use deep breathing techniques.
* Stay engaged with a task or distraction.

sections.heading: Lean on Support
sections.markdown: Inform trusted individuals about the quit plan. Encouragement, accountability, and professional guidance—such as support groups or counseling—can increase the chance of long-term success.

sections.heading: Track and Reflect
sections.markdown: Journaling cravings, triggers, and responses builds awareness and resilience. Every tobacco-free day is a milestone worth celebrating.

sections.heading: Stay Committed After Setbacks
sections.markdown: Slip-ups may occur, but they don't define the journey. Instead of discouragement, choose reflection and recommitment. Quitting is a process marked by courage and persistence.

sections.heading: Make the First Move
sections.markdown:
With a plan in place, the path to a tobacco-free lifestyle becomes clearer. Small, consistent steps lead to lasting change.

Explore resources at [YouCanQuit2,](https://ycq2.org/) or visit your local [Semper Fit](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/recreation-fitness) team for additional information.
